question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.

They wanted me to (expound) on this topic because I had some decent ideas on the subject.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. **'Expatiate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym for "expound" in this context is option 4)** "expatiate".**
 
• **"Expound" **is a verb that means to explain in detail, or to set forth an argument. (विस्तार से समझाना)
 
• **"Expatiate"** means to speak or write in detail on a particular topic.(विस्तार से वर्णन करना)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Expatiate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the meanings of all the words in English and Hindi:
 
 
• **"Paucity" **- The presence of something in only small amounts or numbers; scarcity (कमी).
 
• **"Notoriety" **- The state of being famous or well-known for a bad quality or deed (कुख्याति).
 
• **"Partisan"** - A strong, often uncritical supporter of a party, cause, or person (पक्षपाती).
